Jha, Member** **Date of Order: 30 December, 2019** # **In the matter of:** Extension of validity of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) due to expire between November, 2019 and March, 2020 # ** ORDER ** # **A. BACKGROUND** The Commission vide Order dated 30.04.2019 in Petition No. 4/SM/2019 extended the validity of RECs which were likely to expire between 1 st April, 2019 and 31 st October 2019 up to 31 st December 2019. The relevant extracts of the Order are quoted below:- _“_ . _4. In view of the above, the Commission in exercise of Power under Regulation 15 of REC Regulations extends the validity of RECs which are likely to expire between 1_ _st_ _April 2019 and 31st October 2019 upto 31st December 2019._ _5. Accordingly, RECs which are due to expire between 1st April 2019 and 31_ _st_ _October 2019 shall remain valid upto 31st December 2019._ _6. Petition No. 4/SM/2019 is disposed of in terms of the above.”_ ## **B. REPRESENTATION BY CENTRAL AGENCY ON RECs DUE TO EXPIRE BETWEEN** # ** NOVEMBER, 2019 AND MARCH, 2020 ** 2. From the above inventory, it is evident that 9,514 RECs (4,960 Solar and 4,554 Non Solar) which were issued prior to 01.04.2017, have expired in the month of November 2019. The Commission is of the view that there is a need to extend the validity of these RECs which have expired in November, 2019. 4. Further, it is expected that 2,16,849 RECs which were issued prior to 01.04.2017, are due to expire within the next four months. This includes 29,808 Solar RECs and 1,87,041 Non Solar RECs. The Commission is of the view that there is a need to extend the validity of RECs which are due to expire up to 31 st March, 2020. Order in Petition No. 13/SM/2019 Page 2 5. In view of the above, the Commission in exercise of Power under Regulation 15 of REC Regulations extends the validity of RECs which have expired as on 30 th November, 2019 up to 31 st March, 2020. In addition, the validity of RECs which are likely to expire between 1 st December, 2019 and 31 st March, 2020 is also extended up to 31 st March, 2020. 6. Accordingly, RECs which have expired/are due to expire between 1 st November, 2019 and 31 st March 2020 shall remain valid up to 31 st March, 2020. 7. Petition No. 13/SM/2019 is disposed of in terms of the above. Sd/ Sd/ Sd/ **(I.S. Jha) (Dr. M. K. Iyer) (P.K Pujari) MEMBER MEMBER CHAIRPERSON** Order in Petition No. 13/SM/2019 Page 3
